rows.TEXT:
King's Guard 
"We must tell Demosthene of his son's death. I will tell him the news myself. It is a delicate situation... He is sure to be very upset."

Demosthene 
"This is a day of triumph for us all! You have reclaimed the lost city of Fogfell; and I am sure that the throne shall be mine once more, with your help."

Demosthene 
"Please give this Talisman of Regeneration to fair King Morok, that all your people may live prosperously forevermore."
My wares can help you in your quest.
You'll be cutting a swathe through the land in no time.
In his youth, this mighty lord once stood fast against an army from hell and single-handedly defeated them by sealing the gateway that spew them. He then became sovereign of his realm.

Highest lord of the dwarf lords, she is known for her intensity in battle and her courage in the face of overwhelming odds. She once fought seven days and nights against the mighty red dragon ARFURUZON to finally defeat him.

Dwarf 
"Milord! A young boy! Whatever can he be doing in this place?"

Uther 
"Greetings Clansmen. I came here seeking shelter and the giant of Fogfell has treated me kindly... Your King once ruled this city but it has been independent since the confusion left by the great wars. Let me help unite your Empire once more."

Giant 
"As the last Clan giant of this valley... I am outnumbered. What the boy says is true! None of the Dwarves survived the First Great wars. I was hardier and made a home in the shell of this city called Fogfell. Now, it is yours again."
Primitive Giant"I will help defend your troops against the unruly Giants that trouble this place."

Demosthene 
"This is a day of triumph for us all! You have reclaimed the lost city of Fogfell; and I am sure that the throne shall be mine once more, with your help."

Demosthene 
"Uther, I never dreamed that I would see you again... It has been ten insufferably long years since I lost you.  All my Empire will soon be yours, my son."

Demosthene 
"Please give this Talisman of Regeneration to fair King Morok, that all your people may live prosperously forevermore."

Empire Messenger"Demosthene has been forced to flee his capital! A rebel named Hubert de Lalye has siezed the throne. His vile followers crowd the palace now... I am thankful that Demosthene can rely on your friendship and aid."
Kings guard"Yes, we will capture the cities Frelan, Hasser's Keep and Kalen's Palace. Then the rogue de Lalye will have no chance but to surrender!"

Empire Messenger 
"Many thanks for your kind help. It seems that there is no justice in the Empire nowadays... together we will tame those cities who rebel against the Emperor's rule."

Crossbowman 
"This is most strange: why do the giants threaten us so?! The giant race are our allies... Perhaps they are untamed creatures?"

Dwarf 
"And look! Is that a city in the distance? I think I can see its rooftops through my spyglass... A city in this lonely place?"

Giant 
"Your warriors told me you were seeking to unite the runes. We hold Idun's Prosperity Rune, you will find it in Fogfell..."

Engineer 
"Thank you... I will take this at once to King Morok's Palace."

Tenderfoot  
"We found this orb... It gives off a strange vibration."

Frelan 
"Why help Demosthene? He has no care for his Empire. We will rule ourselves! Let him mope after his son and Queen. It does us no harm anymore..."

King's Guard"Silence Frelan! You have done nothing but turn your back on the King. There is no honor there! Send a messenger to Demosthene, we have captured Frelan and will hold the city until his troops come to claim it."

Uther 
"Yes, you will respect my Father's rule! I am the Empire's Heir!"

Uther 
"Have you no idea who I am, Dwarves? I am Uther, King Demosthene's son! I have no memory of my Father - but I know that I am to be King one day! Do you know where my Fathers land lies?"

King's Guard 
"Oh! We heard of your disappearance, little one... But that was so long ago! Let us take responsibility for your well-being until we can send you to your Father. Follow along, young Uther!"

Novice 
"We have found a staff, my liege."

Kalen 
"The evil fiends are helping Hubert de Lalye against the Empire!"

Peasant 
"Why are you harassing my family, we seek only to escape Kalen's wrath..."

Barbarian 
"How do you wish to die the next time we meet your kind?! We shall oblige you!"

Dwarf 
"Let us stop here awhile, sire. There are kegs of aged malt liquor which it would be a pity to leave behind..."

Loremaster 
"There is no time! We have other things to consider, dwarf!"
Demosthene"How could you have let Uther - a mere boy! How could you let my boy fight the rebels? I had lost all hope that he was alive, and now..."
King's Guard"Demosthene, we are deeply sorry."
Demosthene"Bring me his body, I will prepare a kings burial for my poor, lost, son - who is no more."
Loremaster"It is strange indeed... We wanted to tell you - his body, it has disappeared!"

Uther 
"So, this is my Father's land? I wish to defend it alongside your party.!"

King's Guard 
"Oh no, little one! War does not befit a young boy. The danger is very real! Remember, your Father will be anxious to see you! We must send you further West, where your Father is in hiding..."

Uther"Yes, send word to my Father that I have returned! He will be happy to hear of me... But I have survived the wilderness this long, and have become strong through this experience. I will defend my homeland!"

Dwarf"Wait! The Giant told me tales of his wonderous strength, amazing in one so small and so young! He could be a useful ally in our fight. We should let him avenge his Father's detractors. It is to be his land one day after all..."

Dwarf 
"The wind blows stronger here... It howls around my ears. I think I hear the sound of men reveling to the North."

Rock Giant 
"Strangers are not wanted here..."

Crossbowman 
"Look, an object glitters in the sun! It is hard to dig out of this stony ground..."
Dwarf"The noble giant has gone down in battle. He was loyal to the last!"
Dwarf King"Let us go forth to battle Hubert's forces. Demosthene is relying on our help."
